_source: Real Cloudflare Workers OTLP traces destination export (2026-10-18, agents 0.28.1, Workers Paid), read back from the collector's debug/file output. Spans, ids, kinds, timings and attributes as received, except: test-only header attributes removed, most durable_object_storage_* spans removed, and the caller's location/network, ray id, host, version id and script name (also service.name, faas.name) replaced with placeholders; url.query set to a fake token.

      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

      server_url TEXT NOT NULL,
      callback_url TEXT NOT NULL,
      client_id TEXT,
      auth_url TEXT,
      server_options TEXT
